explanation: Guru Nanak, the founder of Sikhism, was born in 1469 in the Punjab, 14 years before Luther. He was still teaching when Luther wrote his 95 theses in 1517.

claims.text: Guru Nanak, the founder of Sikhism, was born in 1469.
Guru Nanak was born in the Punjab.
Martin Luther wrote his 95 theses in 1517, during Guru Nanak's lifetime; Nanak died in 1539.
